issues.summary: Accepted authored-order evidence can bind mutable build/vc5-final receipts that later final builds overwrite
issues.impact: A routine later final-build invalidates content-addressed accepted evidence and makes strict progress audit fail even though an exact immutable snapshot exists.
issues.next_action: Make import-authored-order fail closed on mutable build/vc5-final paths or copy/hash them into a unique immutable reconstruction-evidence run path, with tests proving a later final build cannot drift accepted evidence.

history.note: Issue recorded for future agent tooling/process repair.

Resolved: progress evidence import-authored-order now snapshots the validated producer receipt into a SHA-256-addressed immutable build/reconstruction-evidence path only after revision/SHA guards pass; dry-run performs no write, destination collisions are non-overwriting failures, and accepted evidence binds the snapshot. Focused/full progress and VC5-build tests, strict progress audit, strict agent-surface audit, and doctor --quick --binja pass.
